content: Customer Rohan Deshmukh called insurance agent Vikram Patel to check on a potential policy cancellation notice. The agent confirmed the policy status is active, attributing the notice to a system glitch. The customer also requested to increase the sum assured from ₹10 lakh to ₹15 lakh, added an accidental death benefit rider for ₹300 per month, updated his residential address, and requested updated policy documents to be emailed to him.

action_items: Email updated policy documents to rohan.deshmukh@example.com
